visualCharacteristics: Two cards per row (calc(50% - 45px), 20px margins), centred; one per row at 900px and below
Full-width photo on top (605:283), dark plum (#3b052e) text panel below, padding 30px 30px 100px, centred
Title in Superior Title 24px/36px taupe #dbcfc7; description Apercu 16px/26px semi-bold white
Red (#eb0028) square uppercase button pinned 20px from the panel bottom; hover plum #5c2642 with dark border
contentPattern: One row per card. Cell 1: picture. Cell 2: title (H3 or bold paragraph), description paragraph(s), last paragraph holding only a link (rendered as the button).
usage: Resource/promo tiles linking to hub pages (e.g. educational resources, calculators). Source: https://www.jackson.com/your-financial-future/how-to-plan-for-retirement.html
reuseGuidance: Use for image-topped promo tiles with a single button. For quotation/persona cards use cards-quote.
